item.title: Show HN: Built an ESP32 remote that groups Sonos speakers and sets group volume
item.summary: My Sonos remote groups all my speakers with one touch. Grouping and volume are what I use most, and going into the app every time is annoying. On the speakers themselves you can only group by walking over to one and long-holding the play button. There is no way to raise the volume of a whole group at all. I am blown away by how quickly this came together and how well it works. I programmed my first C game on a ti92plus in 2000. I read all the code codex wrote and it gave me memories from my early years of coding. The ESP32 is really fast and a great piece of hardware. I am excited to build more.
